name: SHIELD remote (2019)
notes: Verified on SHIELD TV Pro 2019, Android 11, SHIELD Experience 9.2.4: NVIDIA's com.nvidia.shieldtech.hooks (NvNetflix) handles BUTTON_12 at interceptKeyBeforeDispatching, after the accessibility filter, so KeyMapService can take it over. The mic key (ASSIST) is handled earlier and cannot be taken this way.
